related.title: Wi-Fi 7 Puncturing：干擾子頻帶與有效頻寬
related.titleEn: Wi-Fi7 puncturing: interfered subbands and useful bandwidth
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 28 ms completion 與 40 ms completion，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 28 ms completion and 40 ms completion, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋280 Mbit/s ideal與200 Mbit/s ideal，建立puncture_mask.csv、有效頻寬表、模式一致性，並完成以下驗收：250 Mbit/s理想目標只有一塊穿孔配置達成；MAC開銷與合法配置仍需再驗。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 280 Mbit/s ideal and 200 Mbit/s ideal; create puncture_mask.csv, usable-bandwidth table and mask consistency; apply this acceptance decision: Only one excluded block meets a250 Mbit/s ideal target; verify MAC overhead and legal configurations separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 多鏈路可分配資料到不同服務率與延遲的路徑；聚合率受最慢交付與重排緩衝限制。 展開基準式 max(1/100*1000+2,1/50*1000+8)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐鏈路畫首/末位元抵達時間，重排窗口由最早到最晚差決定，不能只比較速率總和。 將兩條推導一起存入 mlo_arrivals.csv、重排緩衝圖、鏈路配置。
從原理 頻寬穿孔排除受干擾區段；合法模式與主要通道限制仍需標準檢查，剩餘頻寬不是無條件可用。 展開基準式 (160-20)*2；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以位元遮罩逐塊計數7與5，驗證排除區未再分配；另外保留合法穿孔模式查核。 將兩條推導一起存入 puncture_mask.csv、有效頻寬表、模式一致性。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Multiple links can divide traffic across different rates and delays; effective aggregation is constrained by completion and reordering., expand baseline expression max(1/100*1000+2,1/50*1000+8); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Plot first/last-bit arrivals per link; reorder span depends on earliest/latest arrival rather than rate sum alone. Save both derivations with mlo_arrivals.csv, reorder-buffer diagram and link assignment.

Starting from Puncturing excludes interfered subbands; legal patterns and primary-channel constraints still apply, so residual bandwidth is not automatically usable., expand baseline expression (160-20)*2; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Count seven/five active blocks from a bitmask, ensure excluded blocks are not scheduled, and separately validate legal puncturing patterns. Save both derivations with puncture_mask.csv, usable-bandwidth table and mask consistency.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LoRa CSS：展頻因子與chirp符元時間
related.titleEn: LoRa CSS: spreading factor and chirp-symbol duration
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 28 ms completion 與 40 ms completion，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 28 ms completion and 40 ms completion, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋1.024 ms/symbol與8.192 ms/symbol，建立lora_symbols.csv、SF/BW一致性表、符元比值，並完成以下驗收：5 ms符元時間上限排除SF10；不能推論SF7一定能達所需範圍或實際封包低於5 ms。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 1.024 ms/symbol and 8.192 ms/symbol; create lora_symbols.csv, SF/BW agreement and symbol-ratio checks; apply this acceptance decision: A5 ms symbol limit excludesSF10; it does not establish SF7 coverage or a full packet under5 ms.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 多鏈路可分配資料到不同服務率與延遲的路徑；聚合率受最慢交付與重排緩衝限制。 展開基準式 max(1/100*1000+2,1/50*1000+8)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐鏈路畫首/末位元抵達時間，重排窗口由最早到最晚差決定，不能只比較速率總和。 將兩條推導一起存入 mlo_arrivals.csv、重排緩衝圖、鏈路配置。
從原理 LoRa符元時間Ts=2^SF/BW；SF增大使符元變長，原始bit速率與實際封包率仍需編碼及標頭。 展開基準式 2**7/125000*1000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：兩者比值應為2^(10-7)=8；以符元頻率倒數重算時間。 將兩條推導一起存入 lora_symbols.csv、SF/BW一致性表、符元比值。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Multiple links can divide traffic across different rates and delays; effective aggregation is constrained by completion and reordering., expand baseline expression max(1/100*1000+2,1/50*1000+8); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Plot first/last-bit arrivals per link; reorder span depends on earliest/latest arrival rather than rate sum alone. Save both derivations with mlo_arrivals.csv, reorder-buffer diagram and link assignment.

Starting from LoRa symbol durationTs=2^SF/BW grows with SF; raw bit rate and packet rate also require coding and headers., expand baseline expression 2**7/125000*1000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: The ratio must be2^(10-7)=8; cross-check by inverting symbol frequency. Save both derivations with lora_symbols.csv, SF/BW agreement and symbol-ratio checks.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
